## Summary
Daily autohealing found real `console.*` usage in `@sparkle/theme` runtime source (not JSDoc examples), violating the project convention "use `consola`, never `console`" documented in `llms.txt` / `.github/copilot-instructions.md`.

- `packages/theme/src/persistence/index.ts` — 7 call sites
- `packages/theme/src/providers/ThemeProvider.tsx` — 5 call sites
- `packages/theme/src/providers/NativeThemeProvider.tsx` — 7 call sites

## Changes
- Replaced all `console.warn`/`console.error` calls in the three files above with `consola.warn`/`consola.error`.
- Added `consola` (`3.4.2`, matching the version pinned elsewhere in the workspace) as a direct dependency of `@sparkle/theme` since it previously had no logging dependency.
- Added a patch changeset for `@sparkle/theme`.

- `pnpm check` — clean (manypkg, types, turbo config, dependency validation, lint)
- `pnpm --filter @sparkle/theme test` — 164/164 passing

- `pnpm build` — all 10 Turborepo tasks succeed, including `@sparkle/docs#build`

## Not included (out of scope / already covered)
- Markdown "missing fenced code block language" warnings — already fixed by open PR #1883, not duplicated here.
- Other `console.*` occurrences found were inside JSDoc `@example` comment blocks, not real runtime code — left untouched.
- Broader `any`/class-declaration/`@ts-expect-error` convention findings are pre-existing and span many files; flagged in the daily autohealing issue rather than auto-fixed here per scope cap.
